snapshot.sourceFile: Raw - Shares - Price MOA DVD - 13 Oct-2026 - BBG.xlsx
notes: The date is taken only from the filename. Quote observation and policy effective times are not supplied.
raw preserves all 20 original ACE fields as exact source strings or null, including vendor error text.
Numeric convenience fields are JavaScript-compatible numbers for filtering and sorting. Display and export raw strings to preserve source precision.
AR groups are proposed navigation bins, not bank policy. Labels 50–69.99, 70–79.99 and 80–89.99 mean [50,70), [70,80) and [80,90).
CPN Rate has no confirmed metric mapping and must not be presented as dividend yield or a universal coupon rate.
Issues are data review flags, not eligibility, suitability or investment decisions. Missing optional quote/duration values alone do not set issues.
This is a source snapshot; no live prices, ticker, FX, issuer-family, sector, maturity or eligibility data have been invented.

issueLabels.missing-isin: ISIN not supplied; record uses a bank identifier or snapshot row ID.
issueLabels.isin-format: ISIN format exception; syntax check only, not an ISIN checksum test.
issueLabels.missing-policy-data: One or more bank policy fields are missing; missing is distinct from zero.
issueLabels.vendor-invalid-security: The source includes the vendor text #N/A Invalid Security.
issueLabels.crossed-quote: Both quote sides are positive and BID is greater than ASK.
issueLabels.nonpositive-last-price: The supplied Last Price is zero or negative.
issueLabels.nonpositive-duration: The supplied Macaulay Duration is zero or negative; requires review.
issueLabels.ar-out-of-range: Fixed AR(%) is outside the proposed 0–100 navigation range.
